overview_description.description:
Finmark is financial planning software for startups; making it simple for companies to manage their runway, hiring, and cash.

The platform takes complex financial concepts and calculations and distills them down into a simple to use interface so companies can easily update, inspect, and share their financial metrics. Companies, from pre-revenue to pre-IPO, rely on Finmark to align teams, drive collaboration, reduce costs and resources, and build the next generation of great startups.

Greg Lissy, Jeremy Neuberger, and Rami Essaid founded the company in Raleigh, North Carolina in 2020.

about_short_description.short_description: Finmark is financial planning software for startups; making it simple for companies to manage their runway, hiring, and cash.

product.name: Financial Modeling and Planning Software
product.description: Software that enables startups to create, manage, and forecast financial plans including runway, hiring, and cash flow.

product.name: Balance Sheet Forecasting
product.description: A tool to project future company assets, liabilities, and equity based on current data and strategic initiatives.

product.name: Budget Modeling and Forecasting
product.description: Frameworks and tools to create, manage, and analyze various budget models tailored to startup needs.

product.name: Budget Variance Analysis
product.description: A service to identify and analyze differences between budgeted and actual financial figures to inform adjustments.

product.name: Cash Flow Projection and Management
product.description: A tool to forecast cash inflows and outflows to ensure sufficient liquidity for operational and growth needs.

product.name: Financial KPI Dashboard and Reporting
product.description: A customizable dashboard to track key financial performance indicators and generate reports for stakeholders.
